DML.SELECT: SELECT transit_image_id as "id", transit_id as "transitId", path as "path", read_only as "readOnly", visible as "visible", created_at as "createdAt", updated_at as "updatedAt" FROM rt.transit_images
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO rt.transit_images ( transit_image_id, transit_id, path, read_only, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES( :id, :transitId, :path, :readOnly, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.UPDATE: UPDATE rt.transit_images SET path = :path, read_only = :readOnly, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE transit_image_id = :id AND transit_id = :transitId
DML.DELETE: DELETE FROM rt.transit_images WHERE transit_image_id = :id AND transit_id = :transitId
